$comment: Single source of truth for DC Hub directory listing copy (Glama, LobeHub, PulseMCP, mcpservers.org, MCP Hive, mcp.so, ...). Edit here; test/listing-copy.test.mjs enforces the copy rules, the 400-char Glama cap, the tool count and that `long` equals scripts/smithery_description.txt. tool_count and the N MCP tools phrases are healed by scripts/sync-tools-manifest.mjs.
short: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center siting. Agents can query it and cite it.
long: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center siting. Agents can query it and cite it. It covers 330,000+ mapped power, grid, gas and fiber assets. It scores 300+ markets daily with the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), and it carries live grid feeds from the seven US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE). Answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. The server has 92 MCP tools at https://dchub.cloud/mcp plus a REST API at https://dchub.cloud/api/v1. The free tier needs no key; a $10 one-time pack adds 1,000 API credits.
